Sharing-file validation uses Ajv 8.17.1 standalone generated code and its
ucs2length runtime helper (MIT; see AJV-LICENSE.txt). The schema is compiled
at maintenance time and bundled with esbuild 0.25.12; neither tool is loaded
from the network when the report is generated or opened.
